args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion in the Coastal reports:

- Covey & Lark Retail was renamed Pellow Home Living on 16 Feb 2026.
- "PHL" now matches two different businesses, Pellow Home Living and Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so filtering on PHL in the morning report returns both (raised in #coastal-team on 17 Feb).
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", the old pre-rename label. It was added to the handoff list, and the stale label was making the receiving supervisor search twice. Related ticket in that digest: PD-4821 (door 6 booking view). We haven't confirmed whether that report has been relabelled since 18 May.

Could you confirm the correct full-name labels (Pellow Home Living / Pellucid Harbor Logistics) and update the saved report and any other views still using "Covey" or bare "PHL"?

Thanks,
Bettina
